runtime_uncertainties: The fixed marked_crosswalk control can support crosswalk alternatives; intersection alternative requires connected native intersection geometry in the same cell.
Sufficient space and obstructing passage have no supplied numeric legal cutoff; raw geometry and motion do not alone resolve judgment.
No physical blocker, exact runner, finalizer, source-bound compatibility or saved audit has yet been implemented.
law_text: No driver shall enter an intersection or a marked crosswalk unless there is sufficient space on the other side of the intersection or crosswalk to accommodate the vehicle he is operating without obstructing the passage of other vehicles or pedestrians, notwithstanding any traffic-control signal indication to proceed.

alternatives_and_boundaries: Intersection entry and marked-crosswalk entry are alternatives; fixed marked_crosswalk control may support both if geometry is present.
Compare enough downstream accommodation versus blocked downstream space, measuring full vehicle body, actual passage obstruction and upstream stop/entry.
Proceed signal does not waive the space condition; include a proceed indication while varying downstream clearance.
Sufficient space and obstruction are judgment phrases without supplied numeric cutoffs.

evidence_review.method: Read the frozen evidence inventory; zero accepted recordings are listed, so no accommodation or obstruction fact can be reused.

gaps.requirement: Downstream free space to accommodate full vehicle body before entry, measured at the actual entry frame
Whether the vehicle actually obstructs passage of other vehicles or pedestrians

st.intersection.evidence: Original Native junction boundary and connected route identify intersection entry.

st.lane_enters.evidence: Original approach and receiving lane connection fixes the corresponding other side.

st.crosswalk.evidence: Original closed Native marked-crosswalk polygon, not a scenario flag, identifies the crossing.

drv.entering_intersection.evidence: First original 20 Hz body intersection with selected region is retained as the entry frame.

rel.surface_gap.evidence: At entry, project downstream occupant bodies onto the connected receiving corridor and retain contiguous free length.

kin.extent.evidence: Original Native ego body dimensions are measured as physical data, without a legal sufficiency cutoff.

drv.following.evidence: Original downstream vehicle identities and body footprints locate the queue relative to ego.

drv.stopped.evidence: Original participant velocity and standing history are needed to identify whether the queue is stopped.

dev.traffic_signal.evidence: Original control actor readback is retained at each frame; a proceed indication cannot waive the space rule.

ru.pedestrian.evidence: Original pedestrian identities and passage polygons are retained; physical route must be independently verified.

rel.occupies.evidence: Original ego body footprint overlap with participant passage polygons is retained after entry, without a legal obstruction verdict.
